```{r, include = FALSE}
source(here::here("setup.R"))
for (file in list.files(here::here("R"), full.names = TRUE)) source(file)
df_test <- readRDS(file.path(output_dir, "df_test.rds"))
best_model <- readRDS(file.path(output_dir, "best_model.rds"))
```

# Submissions

## Predicting test data

```{r}
predictions <- predict(best_model, df_test)
```

## Formatting the submission file

To help you turning your predictions into the right format, the following code can help.

```{r}
df_test_predicted <- df_test |>
  mutate(Predicted = predictions) |>
  select(Id, Predicted)
write_csv(df_test_predicted, file.path(output_dir, "submission.csv"))

# Check the result: print first 20 lines in the submission file
cat(readLines(file.path(output_dir, "submission.csv"), 20), sep = "\n")
```
